unit.title: Application-Layer Contracts: Build and Observe One HTTP Exchange
unit.scope: Implement and test one bounded, loopback HTTP/1.1 GET exchange over a raw TCP socket; study message framing, fragmented reads, timeouts, resource limits, and reproducible evidence.
prerequisites: Ability to implement and test a small command-line program
Familiarity with asymptotic reasoning and finite-state control flow
learning_objectives: Distinguish transport read boundaries from application-protocol message boundaries.
Turn a small protocol contract into separated, testable I/O and parsing components.
Handle malformed input, premature EOF, timeouts, and bounded memory deliberately.
Produce reproducible test and observation evidence instead of relying on prose claims.

unit_completion_requires: Runnable implementation and automated tests produced by the learner
Learner responses to the comprehension prompts
claims_not_accepted_as_evidence: A learner or agent prose claim of completion
Finishing only the reading or reflection

preparation.basis: The catalog description, metadata, and normalized resource records supplied in the job snapshot.
